sourceDocuments.title: Building a three-tier architecture on a budget | AWS Architecture Blog
Fanout Amazon SNS notifications to Amazon SQS queues for asynchronous processing - Amazon Simple Notification Service
Using Lambda with Amazon SQS - AWS Lambda
Parallel workflow state - AWS Step Functions
Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to connect to your data - Amazon Athena

Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda - AWS Lambda

cases.layoutConditions: Two lanes; bent ingress lines; separate storage families.
requiredResourceIntent: Separate static S3 origin and HTTP API paths; Lambda owns business logic and DynamoDB stores application records.
acceptableSemanticVariants: Service-name synonyms are acceptable; support resources are allowed. HTTP API annotation binds the v2 API resource, not a REST API swap.

cases.sourceBasis: AWS documentation specifies Athena querying S3 using Glue metadata and optional crawler schema inference. This drawing explicitly selects crawler, a named workgroup and a separate S3 query-output bucket.

cases.layoutConditions: Dense rectangular layout; long crossing data/SQL lines; distinct metadata and object flow.
requiredResourceIntent: Separate source and query-output buckets; crawler populates the Glue database with schema; Athena workgroup queries source objects and writes query results.
acceptableSemanticVariants: Metadata lookup may be described as Athena -> Glue; read-direction descriptions may reverse the data-flow arrow when the read semantics remain explicit. Crawler may create tables dynamically.

cases.sourceBasis: Independent redraw of documented two-AZ public/private VPC, ALB and Auto Scaling private servers, one NAT per AZ and S3 gateway endpoint. Select IPv4-only explicitly; two ALB nodes represent one logical load balancer.

cases.layoutConditions: Largest case; nested AZ/subnet boundaries; small routing text; shared versus per-AZ resource distinction.
requiredResourceIntent: Two public and two private subnets across two AZs; one logical ALB and ASG; ASG instances are supplied by a launch template, not mandatory standalone aws_instance resources. One NAT per AZ, private egress routing and S3 gateway endpoint.
acceptableSemanticVariants: Route entries may be inline or standalone; ALB/ASG node placement can be expressed as shared resources. No IPv6 or egress-only gateway required.

limitations: All positives are independently recreated reference-based diagrams, not independently collected user uploads or screenshots.
AWS icons are replaced with service labels; icon-recognition fidelity is not measured.
No model results or quality/latency claims exist.
Existing m3 exact-string evaluator cannot by itself judge semantic equivalence, cardinality or detailed boundary intent; this review supplement preserves those human truth obligations.
